cases.reason: Exact one admission / duplicate success / two slots sequence present.
State hook under mutex reentering State/Counts blocks.
No wrapper reassignment or changed receiver behavior.

findings.reason: beforeRequest, isSuccessful, afterRequest, counts and defaultReadyToTrip implement the qualified closed-state sequence.
beforeRequest checks state and capacity before increment; onSuccess/onFailure transition and reset.
Allow closure, generation guard, onSuccess and half-open expiry support duplicate and abandoned callback sequences.
Counts does not refresh; currentState is called before generation comparison, with documented interval and timeout defaults.
setState invokes OnStateChange under caller-held lock; onFailure calls ReadyToTrip under lock, whereas Execute invokes IsSuccessful before afterRequest.
Execute defer covers classifier and reporting; first hook panic can be recovered and trigger a second afterRequest, subject to stated generation and hook conditions.
